key_interactions.effect: Several-fold higher felodipine levels (8-fold with itraconazole); hypotension and tachycardia (label).

key_interactions.action: Consider another antihypertensive or monitor blood pressure closely.

key_interactions.effect: Metoprolol levels up about 31 to 38%; usually well tolerated (label).
